sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief and suiting up for deployment completed.
Commencing Alpha Route; check-in at corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check on stores along Queen Street towards Britomart Square.
Welfare check at Mecca, Dangerfield, Lush, NZ Muscle, 2degrees, all clear.
Walkthrough of the Durham Street West alleyway and welfare check on businesses within the vicinity — Adina City Apartments, Hazy Tiger, BBQ King Restaurant, Kym's Unit — all clear.
Welfare check on the Durham Street East alleyway and businesses within the vicinity, all clear:
Welfare check through Vulcan Lane and all businesses within the vicinity, all clear:
Welfare check at Partridge Jewellery, Pandora, Queens Jewellery, Sail Away Souvenirs, Global Culture, Michael Hills, all clear.
Welfare check at BNZ Place, the BNZ building entrance on Shortland Street, Partridge Jewellery, Pocket Park, all clear.
Welfare check at the Imperial Lane building and sweep around the area, all clear.
Welfare check at Queens Arcade, all clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full sweep around the square, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, Starbucks, Hollywood Cafe, Daily Bread, Deli & Bakery, 4 Square, all clear.
77 Convenience Store corner of Commerce and Quay Streets
Standing by to show presence to morning commuters and the public before moving along to the next and last check-in for Alpha Route.
Welfare check and walkthrough of Commercial Bay Wheirko Lane, all clear.
Welfare check at Aotea Gifts, Woolworths Lower Albert Street, Zibbetto Espresso Bar, Palmer Bar, Ronnies Cafe, all clear.
Response call from Kowhai Cafe at Commercial Bay regarding an aggressive individual outside the store; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at the response call and spoke to the individual; staff accused him of stealing food and eating it, which he denied. Asked him to leave; he complied, but took his time.
Individual has left the response call area.

Tracked the individual back to Commercial Bay Wheirko Lane, where he was causing a disturbance inside the lobby area; the team intervened together with Commercial Bay security. He was also reported to have assaulted a cafe staff member.
Individual is detained until Police arrive; waiting at the lobby area.
Police arrived and took over the situation; the team remains on standby as the individual is becoming aggressive, in case Police need assistance.
Response call from Remedy Cafe regarding an individual they want removed from their tables and seats outside.
Team split: one guard remains with the aggressive individual at Commercial Bay while the other attends the calls at upper Queen Street.
Guard two arrived at the Remedy Cafe response call, after first stopping by McDonald's Queen Street on the way to assist staff with moving vagrants along from the front of the store.
Guard two has dealt with the Remedy Cafe individual and is standing by at upper Queen Street awaiting any calls or incidents, while guard one remains on standby at Commercial Bay with Police.

Update: the individual is still physically and verbally aggressive. Police are on the phone and have not yet taken him; guard one remains on standby with Police and Commercial Bay security due to the busy foot traffic into the lobby area.
Police are escorting the individual out of the lobby area and into their vehicle.
Leaving standby to link up again with guard two at upper Queen Street.
Linked up with guard two in front of Starbucks; recommencing Alpha Route.
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.
Standing by to show presence due to an increased number of families and children playing in Aotea Square.
Ending Alpha Route and commencing Delta Route.
Check-in at Aotea Square, all clear.
Welfare check at Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace, Aotea Centre, Cafe and Bar, all clear.
Check-in at Auckland Town Hall, all clear.
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Check-in at corner of Rutland Street and Wakefield Street, all clear.
Response call from QF Tav regarding an aggressive male individual inside the premises; assistance requested to move him along.
While en route to the response call, received a call back to stand down — the individual has left the premises.
Resuming Delta Route welfare checks: former Gateau House site, Tang Tea, K Save Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at Bentto, Choice Plaza, Sushiya, Choice Backpackers Wellesley Street East, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne Street, all clear.
Welfare check on stores along Lorne Street, all clear:
Arrived back at Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone due to low battery (10%, shown to camera).
While on standby, response call from the former Smith & Caughey's building regarding loud vagrants at the McDonald's Queen Street bench outside; assistance requested to have a word with them.
Arrived; the individuals were not being loud or obnoxious. Spoke with them and they were fine.

Arrived back at Headquarters to grab a charger and Misaea's power bank for use on route. (Request noted for management to supply power banks so the team does not need long standbys to charge the Ops Phone off the weak charger ports.)
Response call from Ippondo requesting a male individual be moved along from the store front.
Arrived at the response call; spoke to the male individual and asked him to move along, to which he complied.
Response call from QF Tav regarding an aggressive male individual — a regular customer, but aggressive for no reason.
Arrived at the response call; the male individual had left. His name is Troy and the owner knows him as a regular.
Standing by to show presence in case the individual returns.
Welfare check on stores along Wyndham Street, all clear:
Check-in at Commercial Bay, all clear.
Report call from Jo & Joes asking the team to keep an eye out for a suspicious individual around the area.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Late response call from Auckland Council requesting assistance with an aggressive male individual at the front of ANZ, 205 Queen Street.
Arrived and dealt with the situation; the individual was making bank staff uncomfortable. Asked him to leave and he was compliant.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Standing by in the office charging the Ops Phone before heading out on patrols.
Welfare check on Victoria Street and all businesses open within the area; patrolling down High Street.
Welfare check on the top half of High Street and all businesses; arrived at Freyberg Place, commencing a full sweep of the area.
Welfare check on O'Connell Street and Chancery Street, all clear; commencing welfare checks in Chancery Square.
Full sweep conducted at Freyberg Place and Chancery Square; welfare checks on businesses in the area all clear. Patrolling down the bottom half of High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues; continuing patrols down High Street.
Welfare check of the whole of High Street and businesses in the area, all clear; patrolling down Fort Lane.
Received a call from management to make our way to the Red Radisson hotel for a welfare check; en route.

As the team was about to head to the Red Radisson, received a response call from St Pierre's Sushi — a young male individual stole from the store and left the area, last seen walking down Queen Street; staff provided a good description. Patrolling both sides of Queen Street to spot the individual with the stolen goods.
Patrolled the whole of Queen Street but could not find the young male described by St Pierre's Sushi staff; heading back up Queen Street.
Welfare check on Victoria Street and Elliott Street; heading to McDonald's Queen Street.
Welfare check at the Unichem Pharmacy store; arrived at McDonald's Queen Street, standing by maintaining presence.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear; heading to the Red Radisson for the welfare check.
Arrived at the Red Radisson; staff advised their door was not working and led the team to the door needing maintenance. Standing by for any issues that occur.
Currently standing by at the Red Radisson.
Red Radisson all clear, no issues; continuing patrols down the walkway to Queen Street.
Arrived at Queen Street; patrolling Mid City for welfare checks.
Arrived at St Pierre's Sushi; retrieving footage and speaking with staff.

Received footage of the young individual who stole from St Pierre's Sushi. (Footage on file.) Staff said more Heart of the City foot patrols are needed. Welfare checks all clear; patrolling up Elliott Street.
Arrived at Elliott Stables; commencing welfare checks and maintaining presence.
Still at Elliott Stables maintaining presence.
Elliott Street and Elliott Stables all clear, no issues; patrolling to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a sweep of the area and maintaining presence.
Full sweep of Aotea Square; welfare checks at Event Cinemas and the gaming centre down to the Civic Theatre, all clear. Heading to Headquarters.
Welfare check at Father Teds and NZ Muscle, all clear; continuing the route to Headquarters.
Arrived at Lorne Street; commencing welfare checks in the area.
Welfare check at the Red Radisson and the Lorne staircase mural, all clear; patrolling down the walkway to Queen Street.
Arrived on Queen Street; commencing patrols down.
Corner of Durham Street all clear — no vagrants taking shelter and no issues; commencing welfare checks at both Wilson carparks.
Welfare check at both Wilson carparks, all clear.
Full sweep of Durham Street, all clear, no issues; continuing welfare checks down Queen Street.
Welfare checks from Farmers and Mecca through to Hallensteins and OPSM; patrolling up Wyndham Street.
Welfare check at Chemist Warehouse, all clear.
Welfare check at the QF Tav bar, all clear; patrolling back down Wyndham Street to Queen Street.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues; patrolling Queen Street to Vulcan Lane.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane; patrolling down High Street.
Full sweep of High Street, all clear; maintaining presence on Shortland Street at Haven Mart.

Approached by a staff member from the Corner Bar regarding a male individual who had obstructed property on their premises; received footage from the staff member. Standing by for any assistance needed.
Welfare check of the whole of Shortland Street and businesses in the area, all clear; patrolling down Fort Lane.
Welfare check at Evans Kebab, KFC, Jo & Joes, The Right Track, Mr Murdochs, Vape Haven — the whole of Fort Lane all clear, no issues. Standing by at Jo & Joes.
Welfare check at Jo & Joes, all clear, no issues; commencing a sweep of Fort Street.
Full sweep of Fort Street; welfare check, all clear. Patrolling down Customs Street West to Commercial Bay:
Full sweep of Customs Street West; welfare check at Customs Mart, 77 Convenience Store and Burger Fuel, all clear. Arrived at Britomart, commencing a full sweep of the area.
Saw a vagrant up at Queen Street running up High Street causing a big disturbance; the team chased him until Police caught up with him. Standing by for any Police assistance needed.
Still with Police and the person of interest; standing by.
Police have left the area; standing by on High Street keeping a close eye on the person of interest.
High Street all clear; patrolling down Victoria Street to Queen Street.
Victoria Street all clear, no issues; patrolling to Darby Street.
Elliott Street, the Elliott carpark, Elliott Stables and the on-site guard all clear, no issues confirmed.
Heading back to the office to commence break and let in the standby guard.
Standing by with a group of individuals having a minor fight with each other; on standby for any issues that occur.
Standing down from the civil dispute; heading back to Headquarters to commence a 30-minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing a 30-minute break and letting in the standby guard. All clear, no issues.
Afternoon Shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Standing by in the office until the second guard arrives.
Guard arrived on site; standing by charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Ops Phone charging completed; gearing up and commencing patrols.
Welfare check on Darby Street, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Bar 101; standing by for any issues that occur.
Welfare check at Bar 101, all clear; commencing a welfare check at the Red Radisson.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street and the on-site guard; heading to the Red Radisson from Queen Street.
Welfare check at the Red Radisson, the broken door and the Lorne staircase mural, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Lorne Street.
Lorne Street all clear; patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.
Welfare check at Dengdeng Bar and Circle K Mart, all clear, no issues.
Standing down the sweep — received a response call from management to head to Bar 101 to assist with a female individual lying on the floor; en route.

Arrived at the location; management was waiting out front. Kindly escorted the individuals away from the location and the area; a small bag of synthetic substances, possibly Class A, was seen in plain sight. Standing by until the vagrants vacate the premises.
Also found a stolen bag with belongings that did not belong to the vagrant; the bag has been taken to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; let in management and placed the stolen bag in the office for safekeeping. Standing by for management.
Standing by at the office for management.
Standing down from Headquarters; continuing patrols.
Welfare check of the whole of Queen Street; patrolling down Shortland Street.
Full sweep of Shortland Street, all clear; patrolling down Fort Lane.
Welfare check at Jo & Joes and The Right Track, all clear, no issues; arrived at Sapphire nightclub, standing by maintaining presence.
Still at Sapphire nightclub maintaining presence (01:30 – 02:02).
Welfare check at Sapphire nightclub; continuing patrols down Fort Lane to Britomart.
Welfare check at Britomart McDonald's and the on-site guard, all clear; no sweep needed, no heavy foot traffic in the area. Patrolling down Quay Street.
Welfare check with the Kemuri guard, all clear, no issues.
Standing by in the middle of Quay Street due to a suspected brawl happening in the area.
Full sweep of Quay Street; commencing welfare checks at Viaduct Harbour.
Full welfare checks complete, all clear, no issues; continuing patrols down Customs Street West to Albert Street.
Customs Street West all clear, no issues; patrolling up Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear, no issues; continuing patrols.
Patrolling through Swanson Street to Federal Square to commence a sweep of the area.
Swanson Street West all clear, no issues; arrived at Federal Square, commencing sweep.
Full sweep of Federal Square; welfare check at the cathedral and Liston House, all clear, no issues. Patrolling back down Albert Street to Victoria Street West.
Welfare check at Albert Street and the Skymart Convenience Store, all clear; patrolling down Victoria Street to Bar 101.
Victoria Street all clear, no issues; arriving at Bar 101.
Arrived at Bar 101; standing by showing presence until closing hours.
Bar 101 closed; standing by until the crowd in the area clears out.
Bar 101 crowd has cleared out; continuing patrols up Victoria Street West to High Street.
Welfare check on Darby Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Victoria Street West; arrived on High Street, patrolling down.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.

Standing down patrols — response call from the Red Radisson guard regarding a male adult who left their premises with 500 dollars in his possession, last seen walking down Queen Street. Patrolling down Queen Street to spot the individual described.
Full sweep of Queen Street; no individual matching the description identified. Patrolling around Britomart to try to spot him.
Arrived at Britomart; patrolling around the area looking for the individual.
After a long search for the male from the Red Radisson who stole the money, no person of interest matching the description could be found. Standing by at Britomart; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear, no issues. Heading back to the office to commence a 30-minute break.
Full sweep of Queen Street; arrived at the office, commencing a 30-minute break.
Streets have gone quiet; standing by at Headquarters awaiting guard handover.
Night Shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.

flags: SENSITIVE: 09:15–10:18 Commercial Bay — aggressive individual reported to have assaulted a cafe staff member; detained by the team with Commercial Bay security for ~1 hour until Police escorted him into their vehicle.
CAPACITY: 09:37 team split — one guard held with Police at Commercial Bay (09:20–10:20) while the second guard alone covered the 09:36 Remedy Cafe call (attended 09:44) and upper Queen Street.
CAPACITY: 15:51 management request for a Red Radisson welfare check was attended at 16:32 — delayed by the 16:00 St Pierre's Sushi theft response taking priority.

NOTE: 12:31 team formally requested management supply power banks — weak charger ports are forcing long standbys at HQ to charge the Ops Phone (Night Shift patrols did not start until 23:27 for the same reason).

capacity.call: Management request — welfare check at Red Radisson
capacity.note: Held behind the 16:00 St Pierre's Sushi theft response.
